outcome: composite of any complication or return to the emergency department within 30 days of hysterectomy
return to emergency department within 30 days
cohort: The study included 2845 consecutive hysterectomies performed by 75 surgeons (23 fellowship-trained, 52 generalists) at 7 hospitals.
finding: Fellowship-trained surgeons were more likely to perform minimally invasive hysterectomy, had higher rates of same-day discharge for laparoscopic hysterectomy, and were more likely to perform cystoscopy, while overall postoperative complications and readmissions were comparable to generalists.
